build_grpcio_channelz_package: run setup.py to build and install the grpcio-channelz Python package
run_preprocess_command: run the preprocess setuptools command to prepare channelz protobuf files before packaging
run_build_package_protos_command: run the build_package_protos setuptools command to compile protobuf definitions for the channelz package
install_grpcio_channelz: install the grpcio-channelz package via pip using setup.py with protobuf and grpcio dependencies
review_NoOpCommand_class: review the _NoOpCommand class that provides a no-op fallback for setuptools commands when channelz_commands is unavailable
